items.title: Trial Balance reporting by week, month, or any period (Mews Operations)
items.summary: The Trial Balance moves from daily-only Excel/PDF exports into a live, interactive report inside Mews, with selectable date ranges and export to Excel, CSV, or PDF.
items.segmentation: US, Canada, Mexico, Panama, Bonaire/St Eustatius/Saba, Costa Rica, Curaçao, Singapore, Puerto Rico

items.title: Manage languages and services on Central products with more flexibility (Mews Multi-Property)
items.summary: Central products can now support multiple languages that automatically propagate to local-level products, and Central/local-level products can be connected via a Central service instead of a service key.
items.pitch: Central products just got more flexible — multiple languages roll down to every local property automatically, and linking products no longer means juggling service keys.

items.title: Automate financial reporting with scheduled exports for deposit and guest ledgers (Mews Operations)
items.summary: Properties can set up recurring, scheduled exports for the deposit and guest ledgers with custom frequency and automatic delivery, instead of running exports manually each time.
items.pitch: No more remembering to pull deposit and guest ledger exports by hand — set the schedule once and the data lands automatically, right when finance needs it for reconciliation.

items.title: Ancillary revenue estimates in Mews RMS
items.summary: Properties can configure Ancillary revenue estimates in Mews RMS, recording typical guest spend beyond the room (dining, spa, etc.), which RMS now factors into rate recommendations alongside room rate.
items.pitch: Properties already earn real money from dining, spa, and other on-property spend — this lets that spend inform the room rate itself. Position it as sharper pricing intelligence, not a new upsell feature.

items.title: Ledger Activity Report focused on meaningful movements (Mews Operations)
items.summary: The Ledger Activity Report now hides self-balancing postings that net to zero, groups remaining entries by source item, and gives every 0% VAT posting its own entry in the tax ledger.
items.pitch: Frame it as a clarity upgrade to the Ledger Activity Report — meaningful movements are easier to find (grouped by item, noise removed), and the tax audit trail is now fully complete for 0% VAT postings.

items.title: Competitor pricing teaser for non-RMS properties (Revenue > Overview)
items.summary: Non-RMS properties viewing Revenue > Overview now see a competitor pricing teaser sitting exactly where the real RMS widget lives, demonstrating RMS value in-product rather than via banner or email. Shared internally in #rnd as a template for surfacing hidden capabilities.
items.segmentation: Shown to non-RMS properties only (~1.5k weekly active enterprises hit that page)

items.title: Flexkeeping now preferred housekeeping solution for all of Accor
items.summary: Flexkeeping (Mews housekeeping solution) has become the preferred housekeeping solution across all of Accor — shared internally in #rnd as a milestone win, no formal release note yet.
